title: Integrate a local trading/research simulator

objectives.text: Compose a complete trusted-caller/versioned pure simulation boundary with point-in-time signal,next-open costs/ledger and independently reconcilable marked-equity summary.
Test integrated authorization/schema/component/summary/replay/failure boundaries without confusing synthetic simulation with external orders,persistent service or real risk qualification.

blocks.markdown: Integration means carrying each component's assumptions across boundaries,not concatenating plausible outputs. This complete capstone embeds the research revision selector,next-open engine and audited backtest facade,then adds a tiny trusted-caller grant boundary,exact request schema and marked-equity summary. It deliberately keeps ONEsynthetic asset/own cents and the same declared cost/capacity model. It is a local trading/research SIMULATION,not an account/broker connection,production service or a combined pricing/covariance/VaRsystem.

The wrapper accepts only fictional upstream-verified student-a/student-band a separately administered frozensetof simulation grants. No grant means PermissionErrorbefore evaluating the request. This is a trusted-input unit boundary,NOTauthentication;do not pass a caller body claim as verified identity. Request schema1has exactly history,opens,threshold,initial_cash,costs. Component validators then check entire raw/clock/numeric/asset domains before any final return. No network,files,real credentials or external order side effect exists.

blocks.title: From authorized candidate request to reconciled summary

steps.text: Own closes100,110,105,108and opens100,101,112,104produce prior-target fills0,0,+1,-1under the embedded model. Buy114plus fee1,sell102less fee1leaves986from1000.
Include initial equity1000and every closing mark:1000,1000,990,986. Running peak stays1000,so maximum absolute marked drop=14cents. Gross traded units=|1|+|-1|=2,not net position0.

Terminal position0and pending target1remain distinct. Summary and detailed audit share run_idand final equity. student-bwithout grant is denied;unsupported schema2fails. Neither error returns a previous successful candidate.

blocks.caption: Expected986 14 2;0 1 OWN-CENTS;replayTrue;simulation denied;invalid simulation request. Complete embedded sources,no fragment imports. Absolute peak-to-later-trough drop is synthetic marked cents,not percentage drawdown,liquidation guarantee,VaRor future bound. Pure all-or-error return,no actual caller authentication,concurrent publication,durable history or live trading.

blocks.markdown: Reconcile final equity with final ledger row,position with signed fill sum,cash with execution prices/fees,gross units with absolute fills,and drawdown with an independent max-over-earlier/later-pairs definition. Initial cash is part of the equity path. Zero initial cash is supported by underlying model,so percentage drawdown would need an explicit denominator policy;this summary avoids inventing one. Do not add USDoption values from the pricing module to own-cent stock simulation outputs without a declared currency/unit/model mapping.

Test denied principal/policy,unsupported schema,unknown fields,malformed late input,missing historical close,future revisions,capacity0,insufficient cash,fees and terminal pending state. A downstream validation failure must not publish a partial success or reuse a stale summary. Test every component with independent references ANDtest composed boundary/error propagation;component green tests alone can miss unit/version/identity mismatches between them.

This bounded max128bar/128revision source is not a measured high-throughput system. Input bounds protect only the modeled workload,not a real transport/parser/server. Record measured runtime/workload if later benchmarking;do not infer asymptotic scale or latency from a classroom fixture. The wrapper adds no persistence,retry store,SQLtransaction,telemetry export,runbook executor or deployment. Those earlier lessons supply concepts/scoped examples,not hidden implemented capabilities.

Keep original data/availability assumptions,request/config/source/build/runtime,selected decision rows,full ledger,summary and verification methods/tolerances bound to the actual revision. Source hashes identify reviewed bytes,not correctness or trusted data. Kernel/run IDdoes not include every operational environment fact and is not a signature. Actual renderer/math/code/task/mobile/a11y/history/offline/recovery/security/production tests remain separate gates. A source simulation cannot sign itself off.

Independent transfer:calculate maximum drop by examining every earlier peak/later trough pair,not copying the running-max loop. Perturb future-only raw rows and verify earlier decisions/ledger prefixes;check summary/raw content IDsappropriately. Revoke a fictional grant and require denial;make a late row invalid and require no candidate. Extend to another currency/asset only after explicitly changing units/schema/validators/evidence,not by changing a label. No live order is part of this transfer.

Inherited sources:[ALFREDvintages](https://alfred.stlouisfed.org/help/downloaddata),[bar execution timing](https://www.backtrader.com/docu/order-creation-execution/order-creation-execution/),[OWASPauthorization](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Authorization_Cheat_Sheet.html),and previous exact source reviews. Own synthetic rule/summary/integration are not a profitable strategy or production-certified library.

summary: The integrated local simulation carries trusted-caller/schema,point-in-time and execution/unit contracts into one audited result. Independent summary and error-boundary tests add evidence,butno real identity/order,persistence,benchmark,app or production qualification is implied.
